rule: One dominant task per viewport
Primary CTA visually dominates secondary actions
Use proximity to show relationships before decoration
Keep repeated card anatomy identical within a collection
Prefer alignment over ornamental separators
Limit simultaneous focal colors
Use whitespace as hierarchy, not unused space
Keep text measure readable for long-form content
Never place equal visual weight on every section
Hero content must state purpose before supporting detail
Proof should sit near claims it substantiates
Filters belong adjacent to the collection they modify
Persistent navigation must remain stable across sibling screens
Destructive actions require separation from primary flow
Use progressive disclosure for advanced controls
Dense tables require sticky context where useful
Mobile primary actions should remain reachable in thumb zones when appropriate
Overlay actions must not obscure critical content
Empty states must teach the next action
Error states must preserve user input where possible
Loading states should match final geometry to reduce layout shift
Motion may reveal causality but not become the hierarchy
Icons require labels when meaning is not universally obvious
Use one image treatment per content family
